items.title: Pay locksmith invoice SD-4471
items.quote: Wir bitten um Ausgleich innerhalb einer Woche, nachdem Ihnen diese Rechnung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: The letter has no date. The period is one week from the day the invoice reached the recipient. The receipt day is not stated. The service was on 06.12.2026, so receipt was on or after that day, and today is 10.12.2026. Without a known receipt day the exact end of the week cannot be computed. If it arrived today (10.12.2026), one week later would be Thursday 17.12.2026. This is only an illustration, not a reliable date.

warnings: The invoice has no date and no receipt date, so the payment deadline (one week after receipt) cannot be fixed exactly. Note the day you received it and count one week from then; to be safe, pay soon, and by 17.12.2026 at the latest if it arrived today.
The invoice gives no payee name beside the bank details and no tax number or invoice date. Check these before paying.

Check the price against what was agreed before the door was opened. The total is 266.56 EUR, including a 60.00 EUR Sunday/holiday/night surcharge and a 35.00 EUR call-out fee. Locksmith overcharging is a known problem. The arithmetic is correct: 224.00 net plus 42.56 VAT is 266.56.
